applies_to.launch: codex exec --json (rollout file is the saved session; the exec stream is a separate live-output contract)

tool_kind_table.note: Name table only; the nested command text is never parsed for classification (owner decision 2026-10-14).

rules.owner: turn_uid = the turn_context.turn_id in force at this ordinal
rules.note: Codex writes the environment context as a user-role message before the prompt; both are user-role records and both map here. The query distinguishes them by content.

rules.activity: 2 Completed (rule codex.rollout.activity.v1: a response_item message is written once, after the response)

rules.owner: response_uid = payload.item.id (same id as the response_item message: two occurrences, one response)

rules.status: 0 Unknown, status_basis 3 Not derivable: the call-level output reports no call-level status; per-command outcomes are operations

attribution.outcome: 1 Unique when exactly one candidate; 2 Ambiguous when more than one (tool_call_uid is then ABSENT and candidates lists them); 3 Unattributed when none

rules.status: status_id 1 when item.status == completed, 2 when failed (Reported: the item carries status)

rules.usage: every event_msg token_count in the same turn before task_complete -> usage_observation scope 3 Prompt turn from info.total_token_usage; the last one is status 2 Final (rule codex.rollout.token_count.v1: last cumulative figure before task_complete), earlier ones 1 Provisional; each cites its own record
rules.cost: none: the rollout reports no monetary cost
rules.status: 0 Unknown with basis 3: task_complete carries no status and no error field here

rules.selector: every other record (session_meta, task_started, developer messages, world_state, turn_context, token_usage_record, token_count)

unavailable_at_source: call-level status of a multi-command exec
